# FILE MAP — `__OMNIMOD_MAP__`

> **This file is owned by AI agents, not by the game.** It is the path index for this map.
> Use it to find files instead of guessing, and regenerate it after creating, renaming or
> deleting ANY file. A stale file map is worse than none, because it will be trusted.
> With the OmniMod MCP: `omni_map_filemap` regenerates it from disk in one call.

## World data — present, and OFF LIMITS

| path | note |
|---|---|
| `level.dat` | world metadata. Never modify. |
| `mapmode.json` | the map’s dual mode (dev / play-preview). Game-owned — switch via `/omni_dev mode` or `POST /omni/mapdev/mode`, never hand-edit. |
| `level0/` | region/chunk data. Never modify. |
| `players/`, `player/` | player data, if present. Never modify. |
